name: desk-tempho1985-seed1-ep150
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT={out} TMPDIR={out}/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}; mkdir -p {out}/desk {out}/tmp; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py desk; {python} research/exp/cache.py --out {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_ep150; {python} research/exp/epoch_variant.py --run {out} --overlay research/overlays/desk_tempho_1985_seed1_ep150.json --cache-out {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_ep150_late --work {out}/late
summarize: import json; s=json.load(open('{out}/desk/run_summary.json')); print({k: s.get(k) for k in ('best_epoch','best_val_kernel','best_val_zmse','epochs_run')})
note: E055b: T0 1986 seed 1, 150-epoch schedule (late = its final epoch)
